== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[Probe Droid Laser (PC 2026 D-E1 card)]]. Compared with [[Probe Droid Laser (PC Errata 2018 E card)]] (by 8 July 2018). The whole 2018 image and the whole D-E1 image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited. Made by placing the two crops side by side (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).
